title: frozen capability-delta definition (v1)
description: Frozen before the subsequent episode runs (AT-13): the element whose class is expected to change, the prediction, and the falsifier. Its digest sha256(JCS(document)) is supplied to `observed capability-delta` from the pre-registration; a delta without it is refused (FALSIFIER_NOT_FROZEN).

old_expectation.description: The element as the old world classifies it (typically an `undeclared:` residual).

new_expectation.description: The newly declared element in the candidate world.

falsifier.description: Conditions that, when true, falsify a GAIN.
